notes.canonical_ir: This repository owns the slot; token-station-south keeps it null in its compatibility.json. Version 5 covers the whole public surface of token-station-protocol 0.7.0. ToolCall gains signature (optional, not serialized when None), which carries the opaque signature a provider issues for one tool call (the thoughtSignature on a Gemini 3 functionCall); a replay must send it back unchanged on the same call. The version 4 content (block-level CacheControl markers, Sampling.top_k, flat reasoning, parallel_tool_calls, ToolDef.strict) is unchanged.
notes.router_config: Tracks router-core's CONFIG_VERSION constant; the boundary gate cross-checks the two on every run.
notes.error_catalog: The ErrorCode catalog with retry semantics kept beside it (13 variants at this mirror state).
notes.stream: Version 3 adds signature to tool_call_delta (optional, not serialized when None), on the fragment that carries the provider's signature. From version 2, a reasoning event keeps index as the choice index and adds block_index for the provider's content block number; an older wire without block_index decodes it as 0.
